cursor.note: PROVED. The allowlist is gone and what replaced it is a property, not a roster: no module the verdict path can REACH — at any depth — may reach a graph tree, port 5432, or a host that could answer. The six dated widenings had one why between them (this module is tree-free), and a list whose every element carries the same reason is a derivation somebody is paying for by hand; the seventh widening was the one nobody paid, and it stood red inside a corpus reported green. THE DISTINCTION WORTH CARRYING IN A YEAR: naming the DENIED capability costs the innocent nothing, so the closure may grow freely while the set sits still — that is the bet, and it is not provable today, which is why it left here as a probe and not as a criterion. TWO THINGS THIS VOYAGE MEASURED AND WAS WRONG ABOUT BEFORE IT MEASURED THEM. (1) I predicted _SOLE_PATH already covered the inference host, so the fire-path rule need not name it. Planting import cairn.devices.inference_domain.route leaves _SOLE_PATH GREEN — inference_domain is precisely the component permitted to dial — while the verdict path gains the ability to ask an LLM. The two rules ask different questions: WHO MAY DIAL versus WHAT THE VERDICT MAY REACH, and the second is not implied by the first. (2) I predicted the new sieve would mirror sole_path_holds exactly, including its per-row attribution. It does not, and the deciding observation was a red rather than an argument: attributing per row rebuilt a 243-file graph 24 times, added 22s to every inspection and timed out this component own proof. Re-read afterwards, the analogy was wrong on the merits too — sole_path binds EVERY component, this binds ONE PATH, and that path is build_inspector. Verdict artifact: verdict-20260812T170623-9e99fc374805.json, 7 criteria pass, 8 hypotheses dispositioned (3 killed, 5 confirmed), deposited to the hypothesize tree. Corpus 100 proofs / 100 green / 0 red, twice; the live trouble the-inspectors-allowlist-tooth-is-red-on-an-import-it-never-admitted is closed by this crossing. Left standing and named rather than fixed: reach_of bands stop at the module boundary, so the two tree-walking sieves band 0 and the nest runs the most expensive meshes first; the dynamic-import check still names 5 modules by hand while the closure holds 17; a subprocess dials and imports nothing.

window.standing: BUILT AND PROVED — the tooth five IOUs were waiting on since 2026-07-18. `import-scan` appeared nowhere in the corpus as code; every occurrence read 'once that tooth exists', and one ruling packet's line 'Guarded by import-scan, never by prose' was itself the only thing enforcing its rule. Promoted rather than invented (Law 1): inference_domain's own sole-path tooth was already AST-parsed, outbound-only and non-hollow — it moved here, widened from cairn/cairn/** (its glob missed 26 files in bin/, skills/, launchers/, learning/) and its hollow floor became a raise inside catches() rather than an assert a second copy could forget. 15/15 green. Three consumers wired at their own addresses, no central rule registry: db_domain's falsifier (4) enforced for the first time in a proof that needs no Postgres; inference_domain's falsifier (6) now delegating instead of carrying a copy; and the ruling door refusing a what_dies path the corpus still imports — which replays the 2026-08-05 defect and names all 19 importers of base/probe.py, where the hand-count had said eight. Verified with a live mutant planted in skills/, missed by the old glob and caught by the sieve. NOT closed: the write-scan (a second writer of intentions-congruency-lab/) is a different verb and stays an open IOU.

window.note: Probe armed at cairn/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_denied_set_stay_put.py — berthed with WHAT IT WATCHES, not with the ticket. It reads the rule from its ONE declaration (inspector._FIRE_PATH) rather than carrying a copy, so it cannot go green against itself while the real set drifts. Baseline written down as provenance: closure 17 modules, denied set 13, both measured today by the same walk the probe runs. The pair is asymmetric on purpose — FIRE on the first GAIN (the ticket's wrong-shape signal, one occurrence refutes), CLEAR only when the set is unchanged AND ten distinct modules have entered the closure, because zero growth against zero closure movement is the misaimed census the librarian already taught us. Exercised before the crossing: census non-empty (244 files, 17-module closure); a planted gain fires the trigger and not the clear; ten planted entrants clear it and do not fire; today neither.
